name: How much does it cost to install a custom ramp or adjust thresholds in my home?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to install a custom ramp or adjust thresholds in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a custom ramp or adjusting thresholds varies widely based on several factors. These include the materials chosen, the complexity of the design, the length and width of the ramp, existing site conditions, and labor involved. Simple threshold replacements might be a few hundred dollars, while a custom, accessible ramp made to code can range from a few thousand to several thousand dollars. We provide detailed estimates after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on materials, design complexity, size, and labor. Simple thresholds are hundreds, custom ramps can be thousands.
